criteria.text: Given an outward command, When the hook runs as a process, Then it emits a decision rather than nothing
Given a catastrophic command, When the hook runs, Then it denies
Given a read-only command, When the hook runs, Then it defers with no output
Given a staged diff introducing a secret, When a commit is attempted, Then the hook denies and names the allowlist command
Given malformed stdin, When the hook runs, Then it defers without crashing
Given the entry bug is reintroduced, When the suite runs, Then it fails
